biotools.summary: NJA-CFS is a Python-based toolkit for crystal field/ligand field calculations on transition metal and lanthanoid complexes, offering various parametrization schemes and tools for CF parameter manipulation. The program is described in a publication with experimental and ab initio comparisons.
